# AI Video Generation

Generate AI videos on RunComfy through one CLI, as a smart router across the video catalog, covering text-to-video, image-to-video and Veo video-extend. Text-to-video routes include HappyHorse 1.0 (native in-pass audio, 1080p, up to about 15 s), Kling 3.0 4K, Seedance v2 Pro and Fast (multi-modal, up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos and 3 reference audio tracks), Wan 2-7 (open weights, audio_url lip-sync to your own voiceover), Kling 2-6 Pro and Seedance 1-5 Pro. Image-to-video routes include HappyHorse, Veo 3-1 and Veo 3-1 Fast, Kling 3.0 tiers, Hailuo 2-3 Pro, Dreamina 3-0 Pro and Seedance 1-0 Pro Fast, plus Veo 3-1 Extend to continue an existing clip. Every run is charged by RunComfy.
